subject.title: fix: preserve discovered context limits over static metadata

question: Should every provider-discovery implementation be allowed to override lower prepared manifest/config/static context metadata, or should this authority be restricted to explicitly trusted discovery sources?
rationale: The linked Copilot contract supports live discovery as authoritative, but the changed helper is shared across all provider-discovery sources and changes compaction budgets outside the Copilot plugin.

options.title: Confirm shared live-first authority
options.body: Treat provider-discovered context metadata as authoritative across the prepared catalog, then rebase this focused patch and rerun exact-head checks.

options.title: Require explicit trusted provenance
options.body: Keep static limits authoritative unless a provider source is explicitly marked trusted, which would require narrowing the proposed generic fallback behavior.

recommendation.title: Confirm shared live-first authority
recommendation.body: Treat provider-discovered context metadata as authoritative across the prepared catalog, then rebase this focused patch and rerun exact-head checks.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Copilot catalog and provider-metadata work makes this person the strongest available routing candidate for the discovery-authority boundary.
